_comment_history: Read-only conversation-archive viewer (GET /api/v1/history/*). DEFAULT OFF: it needs the separate claude-history archive database plus the optional deps in requirements-history.txt. Leave enabled false unless you have both. stale_after_seconds drives the current/stale freshness verdict; past hard_stale_after_seconds the API answers unavailable rather than reading from an old index.
_comment_common_slash_commands: Bare strings still work exactly as before; their short descriptions come from the built-in table in src/core/slash_command_labels.py. Use the object form only to override the wording or to describe a command the table does not know. Keep descriptions under 28 characters - they render on the chip on a phone.
